verdict.rationale: Viam's docs name official language options for all four requested languages: Python and Go for control logic, C++ for lower-level control, and TypeScript (plus Flutter) for client apps. The RDK repo confirms that multiple SDKs exist for client applications, and module docs say the SDKs work automatically with new hardware. Missing for 10: evidence that each SDK covers the full platform surface (fleet, data, ML APIs rather than just machine control), explicit documentation of typed bindings, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality and parity across languages.
